card.line: Mount Hor is a mountain near the border of Edom where Israel camped and where Aaron the priest died after the LORD told Moses to bring him up.

moments.title: Israel camps at Mount Hor
moments.text: After leaving Kadesh, all the people of Israel came to Mount Hor and camped near the border of Edom. There the LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron.

moments.title: Aaron dies on the mountain
moments.text: Moses took Aaron and his son Eleazar up Mount Hor as the LORD commanded. Moses put the priest's clothes on Eleazar, and Aaron died on top of the mountain. Israel mourned for him thirty days.

moments.title: Israel leaves Mount Hor
moments.text: Israel set out from Mount Hor along the route to the Red Sea to go around the land of Edom.
